homeCardBody: Pick a region and the number of days — we suggest a day-by-day plan using services listed on BARQ, with general ideas where there are none.
pageSubtitle: A suggested plan you can edit — nothing is booked until you confirm it yourself.
regionTitle: Where would you like to go?
startDateHint: With a date we check the available times for each day.
generatingHint: We use only services listed on BARQ in the region; availability is confirmed when you book.
errorRetryable: We couldn't create the plan right now. Please try again.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
errorInvalid: Please check your choices and try again.
planDisclaimer: This is a suggested plan, not a booking. Prices and times are confirmed only when you book.
planPartial: Some days have no services available on BARQ in this region — we show general suggestions instead.
planNoServices: There are no services on BARQ in this region yet — the whole plan is general suggestions. Try another region or check back later.
travelTimeUnavailable: Travel time between stops is not available — plan it yourself.
badgeCheckOnBooking: On BARQ — availability checked when you book
generalNote: Not verified and not a bookable service.
dayCost: BARQ services estimate for this day: {range}

checkNoSlot: No time with enough seats is available on this day.
checkUnavailable: This service is no longer available on BARQ.
alternativesEmpty: No other alternatives in this region.
noteSunAndWater: Carry water and sun protection for outdoor stops.
noteFamilySuitability: Check each activity's details for suitability for children — BARQ has not verified this.
noteAccessibility: Accessibility is not verified — check with the provider before booking.
noteBookAhead: Without dates we don't check times — availability is confirmed when you book.
noteCheckDetails: Review each service's details (what's included, meeting point) before booking.
